review_method: Root agent visually inspected the actual Godot GPU comparison. The board combines four actual scene captures, with no artistic mockup replacing the TileMap output.
visual_findings: Concrete aggregate, worn teal paint and flush grey-white ceramic grid are visually distinct at the existing native scale.
All three maps keep the original robot, station, rail, hatch, coping, facade and bridge geometry.
The mixed map contains all seven materials and keeps a continuous ground surface across material boundaries.
Ceramic grout is an albedo pattern; it does not create inner facade, coping or collision geometry.
limits: New art is awaiting user visual review.
Panel seams, hatch and rails remain independent decorations.
Collision and navigation are outside this material extension.
